name: zhizhang
description: 织章：本地优先的中文写作桌面工作台（番茄长篇与今日头条）

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/toutiao/skill/tests -p "test_*.py" && python3 -m unittest discover -s packages/fanqie/skill/tests -p "test_*.py" && node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs test/engine/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @zhizhang/desktop && playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack -w @zhizhang/desktop
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack:portable -w @zhizhang/desktop
